content:
Ted Lasso returns for its fourth season this week (watch here), and Apple yesterday announced a creative promotional event: a Ted impersonation contest at Apple Fifth Avenue in New York.

The "Gathering of the Teds" will be held at Apple Fifth Avenue, featuring three rounds of elimination.

Apple TV's most anticipated new show of the year debuts this week.

Ted Lasso season 4 will premiere at 9 AM Hong Kong time on Wednesday, which is 9 PM Eastern Time / 6 PM Pacific Time on Tuesday in the US.

With a valid Apple TV subscription, you can watch Ted Lasso here.

To celebrate the show's return, Apple's marketing team has put together a special event: a Ted impersonation contest in New York City.

This Thursday—August 7, 5 AM Hong Kong time—a "Gathering of the Teds" will be held at the Apple Fifth Avenue plaza.

According to the official website gatheringoftheteds.com, the contest consists of three rounds, with contestants being eliminated after each round:

Round 1 ("Ted Energy") will be scored based on contestants' in-character self-introductions and a two-minute dance segment... Round 2 ("Head Coach") will be scored based on finalists' performance in a trivia game, as well as their dedication to the Ted Lasso character... In Round 3 ("Ted Talk"), finalists will deliver a short motivational speech to the live audience.

The complete rules for the contest, including the judging criteria for each round, are posted on the website.

Prizes: "A total of four (4) prizes with a combined approximate retail value (ARV) of USD 300, including custom football scarves (3) for each finalist, and custom Beats headphones (1) for the grand prize winner."

Would you enter a Ted Lasso impersonation contest? Share with us in the comments.

Apple TV costs USD 12.99 per month, and is also available as part of the Apple One bundle.
